expected: Sandboxed resource preview frames load without browser console errors under the strict preview CSP.
actual: WebKit logs one style-src CSP error for each loaded preview frame. Direct /preview rendering and the resource content still render, but the console is not clean.
console: Refused to apply a stylesheet because its hash, its nonce, or 'unsafe-inline' does not appear in the style-src directive of the Content Security Policy.
framePolicy: default-src 'none'; script-src <origin>/_astro/ <build-certified hashes>; style-src <origin>/_astro/ <build-certified hashes>; style-src-elem <origin>/_astro/ <build-certified hashes>; style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'; ...
reproduction: Run the Sites compatibility Worker with WebKit.
Wait for the first actual resource preview and inspect the browser console.
rootCause: Unresolved. Each affected frame reports a style-src-elem violation for an inline style whose observed text hashes to an allow-listed value and whose rule still computes as display: contents. The evidence cannot establish whether a separate transient style is blocked or WebKit emits a false-positive event for the authorized style.
securityImpact: No policy relaxation has been applied. The defect is a browser compatibility failure under the current exact-hash policy.

reproductionResult.webKitDesktop: Reproduced: 6 CSP console errors while onboarding results mounted.
reproductionResult.webKitMobile: Reproduced: 2 CSP console errors while onboarding results mounted.
reproductionResult.browserCancellations: Variable as filtered cards unmount; latest confirmation run recorded 9 desktop and 0 mobile preview request cancellations. No failed essential requests.
reproductionResult.isolatedCspScenarios: 8 passed across desktop and mobile, including inline style rendering and opaque-origin isolation.
